questions.question: Use doubling and halving to work out 16 times 25.
questions.expected_answer: Halve 16 and double 25 to get 8 times 50. Halve and double again to get 4 times 100, which is 400.

questions.question: Work out 199 times 12 by rounding and compensating, and explain the compensation.
questions.expected_answer: 200 times 12 is 2 400. Using 200 instead of 199 adds 1 extra for each of the 12 tickets, which is 12 too many, so take 12 off: 2 388.

questions.question: Work out 48 times 15 by breaking down and check your answer by division.
questions.expected_answer: 48 times 10 is 480 and 48 times 5 is half of that, 240. 480 plus 240 is 720. Check: 720 divided by 15 is 48, so the answer is right.
